description: This circular walk explores Hodder's Combe and Round Hill near the village of Holford in the Quantocks AONB. Start off from the public car park in Holford where you can pick up trails heading west into Hodder's Combe. The sheltered Combe is lovely place for a peaceful stroll with woodland paths, a pretty stream and a waterfall to see. The route then continues up to Round Hill and and Longstone Hill where you can enjoy some fine views over the surrounding hills and countryside. You then head east back through the Combe to return to Holford where there are refreshments options at the Plough Inn. The historic 16th century inn is also dog friendly.
